### 6 Key Decisions Made

1. **Agent Scope** — One unified agent with configuration overlays
2. **Authorization** — Hybrid tokens + fallback to GitHub-native
3. **WordPress Support** — Optional per-repo (WPCS, PHP, hooks)
4. **Testing** — Three-tier strategy (Unit 90% + Integration + E2E)
5. **Documentation** — Comprehensive with 8 Mermaid diagrams
6. **Location** — Planning in `.github/projects/`, code in `agents/` root
